## Passive Avoidance Test

Boxplots and individual scores

```{r, include=FALSE}
getwd()
```


```{r pa_load_data_c123}

#----------------------1. MANUAL ENTRIES & 2. LOAD DATA-----------------------#

# cohort 1
cohort1 <- choose.files()     
data1 <- read.csv(cohort1, header=T, skip=1, sep =";", dec = ",")
data1 <- data1[-1,]
data1$cohort <- "1"
data1 <- data1 %>% 
  mutate(Animal = as.character(AnimNo)) 

# cohort 2
cohort2 <- choose.files()     
data2 <- read.csv(cohort2, header=T, skip=1, sep =";", dec = ",")
data2 <- data2[-1,]
data2$cohort <- "2"
data2 <- data2 %>% 
  mutate(Animal = as.character(AnimNo)) 

# cohort 3
cohort3 <- choose.files()   
data3 <- read.csv(cohort3, header=T, skip=1, sep =";", dec = ",")
data3 <- data3[-1,]
data3$cohort <- "3"
data3 <- data3 %>% 
  mutate(Animal = as.character(AnimNo)) 

# Create data file with all cohort data
list_df123 <- list(data1, data2, data3)
data123 <- list_df123 %>% reduce(full_join, by=NULL)

# Load lookup data files
lookupfile <- choose.files()  

# Read lookup data files
lookup <- read_excel(paste(lookupfile,sep = ""))
lookup <- lookup %>% 
  mutate(Animal = as.character(Animal),
         cohort = as.character(cohort)) 

# combine exp data with lookup data
data_pa <- full_join(data123,lookup , by= c("cohort", "Animal"))
data_pa$cohort <- as.numeric(data_pa$cohort)

# need genotype to be factor for later stat analysis
data <- data_pa %>% mutate(geno = as.factor(genotype))

## Extract relevant data
data <- data %>% 
  select (Animal, sex, geno, cohort, Visits.Bright, Visits.Dark, Time.Bright, Time.Dark, Latency) %>%
  mutate(Time.Bright = Time.Bright/1000,
         Time.Dark = Time.Dark/1000,
         Latency = Latency/1000)

```

```{r stat_func, echo=F}

# list of gender
list_of_genders <- c("F", "M")
list_of_genders <- as.factor(list_of_genders)

# list of genotypes
list_of_genotypes <- c("Cre+", "hM4D+", "WT") 

# BETWEEN GENOTYPES
stats_bgeno <- function(data, parameter, info_text, grouping_factor="geno") {
 
  #create a tibble to collect all stats
  stats = tibble()
  
  df <- data %>%
    rename(param = all_of(parameter),
           group = all_of(grouping_factor))
    
    stat_data <- df 

    # perform Pairwise Wilcoxon Rank Sum Tests to compare between group difference
        st = tidy(pairwise.wilcox.test(stat_data$param, stat_data$group, p.adjust.methods = "BH", exact = FALSE)) %>%          
       mutate(method = "Pairwise Wilcoxon Sum",
              variable = info_text,
              test = paste("between genotypes"), 
              sign = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))
 
  #combine stats from every iteration of the loop
  stats = bind_rows(stats, st)
return(stats)
}

# BETWEEN GROUPS
stats_bgr <- function(data, parameter, info_text, grouping_factor="LD") {
########### param = Dur 
  #create a tibble to collect all stats
  stats = tibble()
  
  df <- data %>%
    rename(param = all_of(parameter),
           group = all_of(grouping_factor))
  
  for (i in 1:length(list_of_genotypes)) {
    stat_data <- df %>%
      filter(geno == list_of_genotypes[i])
    
    # perform Wilcoxon Rank Sum Tests to compare between group difference
    st = tidy(wilcox.test(param ~ factor(group), stat_data, exact = FALSE)) %>%         
       mutate(method = "Wilcoxon Sum",
              variable = info_text,
              test = paste("between light & dark for", list_of_genotypes[i]), 
              sign = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "*", ""))
 
  #combine stats from every iteration of the loop
  stats = bind_rows(stats, st)
    }
return(stats)
}

```

### Results

#### Number of visits to the dark side (All Cohorts)

```{r pl_dVisit, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6}

#----------------------------------3. ANALYSIS--------------------------------#

# 3.1 Number of visits to the dark side

pl_dVisit <- data %>%
#  filter(cohort == 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = geno, y = Visits.Dark, color = geno, label ="")) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(aes(colour = geno),
             position=position_jitter(w=0.2, h=0.2)) +  
  labs(x="", 
       y = "Number of visits",  
       title = "Number of visits to the dark side") +
  theme_pubr() + 
  #define position of 'n='
  stat_n_text() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12))

pl_dVisit

```

__Figure 1.__ Comparison of number of visits to the dark side between genotypes.

__Statistics for Figure 1. Number of visits stats__

```{r number of visits stats}

# Stats for Figure 1 (COMPARISON BETWEEN GENOTYPES)

#create a tibble to collect all stats
stats = tibble()

stats_fig1 <- stats_bgeno(pl_dVisit$data, "Visits.Dark", "Fig 1, visits to dark") 
stats = bind_rows(stats, stats_fig1)

#format the table
stats%>%
  #remove horizontal lines between rows
  kable(booktabs = T) %>%
  #prevent table from floating and scale it to page-width
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position","scale_down"))

```

\newpage

#### Time in the light side vs the dark side (All Cohorts)

```{r pl_time, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6}

# 3.2 Time in the light side vs the dark side

pl_Time <- data %>%
  select(`Time.Bright`, `Time.Dark`, `Animal`, `sex`, `geno`, `cohort`) %>%
  rename(Light = `Time.Bright`,
         Dark = `Time.Dark`) %>%
#  filter(cohort == 1) %>%
  gather(key = "LD", value = "Dur", -`Animal`, -`sex`, -`geno`, -`cohort`) %>%
 
#  ggplot(aes(x = LD, y = Dur, color = factor(LD), label ="")) +
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(LD, level=c("Light","Dark")),y = Dur, color = factor(LD, level=c("Light","Dark")), label ="")) + # change bar and color order  
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid (~geno) +  
#  geom_point(aes(colour = factor(LD)),
  geom_point(aes(colour = factor(LD, level=c("Light","Dark"))), # change color order
             position=position_jitter(w=0.2, h=0.2)) +
 
  labs(x="", 
       y = "Time (s)",  
       title = "Time spent in the light side vs the dark side") +
  theme_pubr() + 
  #define position of 'n='
  stat_n_text() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12))

pl_Time

```
